name: DevelopingPolaroidRow
job: Show photos as instant prints that slowly develop from milky blank to full colour as they scroll in, then straighten when hovered
visitor_action: scroll the scene into view to develop the prints; hover or focus a print to shake it and hurry the develop; click, tap, Enter or Space enlarges it, Escape sets it down
mobile: hero print plus 2 supporting prints, all fully in frame, tap enlarges
motion: prints drop onto a studio sweep, rest milky for a beat, then develop in a staggered chemical wave — blue-green blotches clear, colour overshoots and a flash bloom pops as it lands, the emulsion rim lingers last and captions ink in; the develop replays each time a print scrolls back into view; hovering or focusing a finished print shakes it and develops it again faster (a print still developing is hurried) (reduced-motion: prints lie still, fully developed)

checks.render: skipped (Guy 2026-11-23, token saving: no shots, no self-scoring)
checks.craft: skipped (no self-scoring; Guy reviews in the gallery)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Studio flash: cool grey seamless sweep with a soft flash hotspot, glossy white instant prints with real slab edges, a chemical blue-green develop that clears in blotches leaving an emulsion rim, blue-ink handwritten captions
notes: 2026-11-23: redesigned (batch B) to Studio flash. Caveat is now self-hosted (fonts/caveat.woff2). Hover hurry drives the CSS animations via Web Animations playbackRate; browsers without getAnimations keep the shake but skip the speed-up. No render/craft pass this round (token saving), so mid-develop stills are unverified in a browser. 2026-11-23: quality redo (Sonnet 5.5). Gallery review saw a finished static row: the develop played once and was over before anyone looked. Now prints rest milky 0.7s before developing (stronger blotches, colour overshoot and flash bloom), replay whenever they re-enter view, and hovering/focusing a finished print clouds it over and develops it again (still-developing prints are hurried instead). Broken images fall back to blank emulsion. Hurry now targets animations by element, not keyframe name. Unverified in a browser (no shots). 2026-11-23: composition final round. Rebuilt from a bottom-cropped scrolling row to a full-frame worktable scene: hero print front and centre, up to 5 scattered prints at varied angles (some half cropped by the frame edge), strobe pool + raking sweep as light on the table. Container tiers show 3 prints (<560), 5 (<1000), 6 (wide); only the first 6 photos render. No horizontal scroll any more. Unverified at 375/1280 beyond one 683px browser look (shot.sh not run, final sweep judges).
